parsed.rationale: The Target.Com Product Search API (rank 7) can return a paginated list of products (including books) by keyword and store_id, which can be used to filter by author criteria. It directly supports pagination and search, fitting the subtask to fetch a paginated list of books by various authors. Other APIs are unrelated or do not provide book listings.
